findings.closure: Legacy annotations and annotation drafts without parentCollection are no longer inferred from a single same-ID parent. Only types that map to exactly one top-level collection keep legacy expansion.
Filtered list scopes treat tags and search text as membership fields, so an off-page child that changes tags now invalidates the filtered page and triggers a bounded refetch.
Projection recovery validates page identity (query, tag, sort, cursor, direction) and detail root identity plus found state; mismatched projections are rejected instead of reused.
The historical supplement reservation now covers both queue slots and actual remaining budget, reserving one of each for a failed daily repair.
